clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 斯坦福捐赠基金CEO罗布·华莱士：从芭蕾舞者到**掌门人
title_lines: 斯坦福捐赠基金CEO罗布·华莱士
管理500亿美元，专注长期影响力
title_highlights: 斯坦福捐赠基金CEO罗布·华莱士
管理500亿美元，专注长期影响力

subtitles.en: We want to be very impactful for the current generations of students and scholars that are here right now at Stanford.
subtitles.zh: 我们希望为斯坦福当前的学生和学者带来深远影响。

subtitles.en: But we want to be equally as impactful for all future generations of students and scholars.
subtitles.zh: 同时，也要为未来的所有学生和学者留下同等影响。

subtitles.en: Find the people that you respect, that you enjoy, and that you can learn from.
subtitles.zh: 找到你尊重、喜欢并能从中学习的人。

subtitles.en: He now runs one of the largest university endowments. And Stanford Management CEO Rob Wallace says his previous job as a professional ballet dancer
subtitles.zh: 他现在管理着最大的大学捐赠基金之一。斯坦福管理公司CEO罗布·华莱士表示，他之前作为职业芭蕾舞演员的经历，

subtitles.en: prepared him well for the pressures of managing money. Stepping on onto the stage of a major opera house in front of three or four thousand people
subtitles.zh: 为他应对资金管理压力做好了准备。走上大歌剧院舞台，面对三四千人表演高难度芭蕾，

subtitles.en: to do a hard ballet is probably the most acute pressure I've ever felt in my life.
subtitles.zh: 可能是我一生中感受过的最强烈的压力。

subtitles.en: Wallace spent 16 years dancing on some of the world's biggest stages, including the Kennedy Center and the Metropolitan Opera. He retired at 32, enrolled at Yale as a freshman,
subtitles.zh: 华莱士曾在肯尼迪中心和大都会歌剧院等世界顶级舞台跳舞16年。32岁退役后，他进入耶鲁大学读大一，

subtitles.en: graduated summa cum laude, and never looked back. At Yale, Wallace in turn for David Swenson, the pioneer of modern endowment investing, who quickly took him under his wing.
subtitles.zh: 以最优等成绩毕业，从此一往无前。在耶鲁，华莱士师从现代捐赠基金**先驱大卫·斯文森，后者很快将他纳入麾下。

subtitles.en: And as Wallace planned to get an MBA, Swenson had another idea.
subtitles.zh: 当华莱士计划攻读MBA时，斯文森另有想法。

subtitles.en: David Swenson said to me, you're too old to get an MBA. If you stay and work your full time, I think I can give you a lot of opportunities to learn and grow as an investor.
subtitles.zh: 大卫·斯文森对我说：你年纪太大，不适合读MBA。如果你留下全职工作，我想我能给你很多学习和成长的机会。
